q.d0: We need this to calculate your calories
q.d1: Your whole plan is built on this
q.d2: So we pick the right volume
q.d3: Pick the days you can train

levels.beginnerD: First time or under a month

schedule.cardioD: Brisk walk or bike at a conversational pace.
schedule.restD: Muscles grow while you rest. Sleep 7 to 9 hours and drink your water.

meals.note: Meals are built on your calories and diet ({{diet}}). Swap any meal you don't like.

water.tip: 💡 A glass when you wake up, one 30 min before training, and sips during your workout.

shopping.title: 7-day shopping list
shopping.note: Quantities are estimates based on your meals for the coming week.

supp.introD: Food, sleep and training matter way more. Here's a simple guide if you want to use something.
supp.warn: ⚠️ Ask your doctor before any supplement, especially with a chronic condition or medication.

whey.name: Whey protein
whey.desc: Fast protein from milk. Just food, not magic. Helps you hit your protein goal.

creatine.name: Creatine monohydrate
creatine.desc: Slightly boosts strength and performance. Safe for healthy people and heavily studied.
creatine.dose: 3 to 5 g daily, any time, no loading

vitaminD.name: Vitamin D
vitaminD.desc: Deficiency is common even in sunny regions. Get tested first.

omega3.name: Omega-3
omega3.desc: Good for heart and joints. Fish twice a week covers it.

caffeine.name: Caffeine (coffee)
caffeine.desc: Pre-workout energy. One coffee is enough. Avoid late afternoon to protect sleep.

bcaa.name: BCAA
bcaa.desc: If your daily protein is enough, no extra benefit. Save your money.

live.resumeTitle: You have a workout in progress 🔥
live.swapHint: Machine taken? Pick an alternative for the same muscle.
live.firstTime: 💡 First time? Start light enough to do every rep with good form. We'll suggest a weight next time.
live.quitBody: Logged sets will be saved as a finished workout. If nothing was logged, it gets deleted.

summary.title: Great job, champ! 🏆
summary.streakD: Keep going! Rest days don't break your streak.
summary.tip: 💡 Eat a protein-rich meal within 2 hours and drink your water.

march.name: March in place
march.how: Lift your knees and swing your arms, easy pace.

jacks.name: Jumping jacks
jacks.how: Open legs and arms with a light hop, or step out for low impact.

armCircles.name: Arm circles
armCircles.how: Small then big circles, forward then back.

hipCircles.name: Hip circles
hipCircles.how: Hands on hips, slowly circle both directions.

bwSquats.name: Easy squats
bwSquats.how: Slow bodyweight squats through full range.

inchworm.name: Inchworm
inchworm.how: Bend over, walk hands out to a plank, walk back.

catCow.name: Cat-cow
catCow.how: On hands and knees, round then arch your back with your breath.

walk.name: Easy walk
walk.how: Walk slowly and let your heart rate come down.

quadStretch.name: Quad stretch
quadStretch.how: Pull your ankle toward your glute. 15 s per leg.

hamStretch.name: Hamstring stretch
hamStretch.how: Leg forward, hinge with a flat back.

chestStretch.name: Chest stretch
chestStretch.how: Hand on a wall, rotate your body away.

childPose.name: Child's pose
childPose.how: Sit on your heels, reach forward, relax your back.

breathing.name: Deep breathing
breathing.how: Inhale 4 s through the nose, exhale 6 s through the mouth.

progress.weightEmpty: Log your weight at least twice to see the chart. Best time: morning, before eating.
progress.avgHint: Bold line = 7-day average. Daily weight swings with water and salt, don't stress it.
progress.measureEmpty: Log waist and neck to estimate body fat.
progress.strengthEmpty: Finish a weighted workout to see this chart.
progress.strengthHint: Estimated 1RM: the max you could lift once
progress.photosEmpty: Take a photo every 2 weeks, same spot and lighting.
progress.photosPrivacy: Photos stay on your phone unless you enable cloud upload in Account.
progress.measureTip: 💡 Waist at the navel, neck just below the Adam's apple. All fields optional.
progress.driftMsg: You're now {{w}} kg. Update your calories and plan?

account.title: Account & sync
account.localDesc: Your data lives on this phone and works offline. Sync needs a Supabase project (see docs/PHASE-5.md).
account.signInDesc: Sign in so you never lose data and sync across devices
account.privacy: Your data is private and only visible to you.
account.cloudPhotosD: Private folder only you can access. Off by default.
account.deleteWarn: All your cloud data and photos will be permanently deleted. Data on this phone stays.

rem.title: Reminders
rem.server: Works even when the app is closed ✓
rem.signInHint: Sign in to get them when the app is closed
rem.localOnly: Only while the app is open
rem.iosNote: 📱 On iPhone: add the app to your Home Screen first (iOS 16.4+).

coach.intro: Ask me about your workout, food, how to do any exercise, or if you're tired today.
coach.disclaimer: General advice only, not a substitute for a doctor.
coach.myReadiness: My readiness today is {{s}}/100, what do you suggest?

q.protein: How much protein do I need?
q.squat: How do I do a barbell squat?

advice.high: Full session, try to beat your numbers.
advice.veryLow: One less set and 15% lighter, or just take a walk.

prog.deloadDesc: Your body needs to recover to get stronger. One less set and 10% lighter this week.
prog.lightDesc: We trimmed sets and weights based on your sleep and energy.

ch.title: 30-day challenges
ch.intro: Pick a challenge and stay consistent for 30 days. Completing one gives 300 XP and a badge.
ch.missedNote: Missed {{n}} day(s). No worries, keep going!

auto.water: Logged automatically when you hit your water goal
auto.workouts: Logged automatically when you finish today's workout

consistency30.name: Consistency challenge
consistency30.desc: Don't miss a scheduled workout for 30 days

water30.name: Water challenge
water30.desc: Hit your water goal every day

ramadan.tip: Train after taraweeh, break your fast with dates and water, spread water between iftar and suhoor.

data.intro: Your data is yours. Export it as a file, restore it on another device, or erase it all.
data.badFile: This is not a GymMate backup file
data.importWarn: This will replace your current data with {{n}} records from the file. Continue?

resched.movedT: Missed {{day}} on {{from}}? No worries, moved it to {{to}} 💪
resched.movedD: We kept the same order for the rest of the week and never more than 2 days in a row.
resched.dropped: Week rearranged. {{n}} session(s) will not fit, and that is fine. Consistency beats perfection.
resched.toggleD: If you miss a day, we move the session automatically
resched.comebackT: Welcome back! It has been {{d}} days 👋
resched.comebackD: Your first two sessions are 10% lighter with one less set so you ease back in safely.

photo.privacy: Photos are analyzed and never stored

form.ctaD: Counts reps and flags form issues. Runs on your device

squat.t1: Place the phone on the floor or a shelf, side view, 2 to 3 m away
squat.t2: Your whole body must be visible, head to ankles
squat.t3: To check knees, film from the front

pushup.t1: Place the phone on the floor, side view
pushup.t2: Keep shoulders, hips and ankles in frame

hinge.t1: Film from the side at hip height
hinge.t3: Use a light weight the first time

cue.depth: Go deeper, hips to knee level
cue.chestUp: Chest up, keep your back straight
cue.kneesOut: Push your knees out over your toes
cue.hipsSag: Brace your core, hips are sagging
cue.hipsPike: Lower your hips, one straight line
cue.lockout: Finish the rep, squeeze your glutes
cue.pushupDepth: Lower, chest close to the floor
cue.kneesSoft: Less knee bend, hinge from the hips
cue.visible: Step back so your whole body is in frame
